description: This file defines the TaskSchedulerLog class, representing a log entity for task scheduling within the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the ohrm_task_scheduler_log database table and includes properties like id, startedAt, finishedAt, command, input, and status, along with their setter methods.

classes.name: TaskSchedulerLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a log entry for scheduled tasks, including timing, command, input, and status information.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the log entry.

methods.name: setStartedAt
methods.description: Sets the start time of the task.

methods.name: setFinishedAt
methods.description: Sets the finish time of the task.

methods.name: setCommand
methods.description: Sets the command executed in the scheduled task.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the input parameters for the task.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status code of the task execution.
